reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id,
  (SELECT ph.list_price_eur FROM price_history ph WHERE ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL) AS list_price_eur,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM competitor_prices cp WHERE cp.product_id = p.product_id) AS n_checks
FROM products p
WHERE p.category_id = 17
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, ph.list_price_eur, COUNT(cp.product_id) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 17
GROUP BY p.product_id, ph.list_price_eur

WITH checks AS (
  -- one row per checked product
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.product_id, ph.list_price_eur, COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 17

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, ph.list_price_eur, COUNT(cp.product_id) AS n_checks
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category_id = 17
GROUP BY p.product_id, ph.list_price_eur
other_way.tradeoff: Joins and GROUP BY give the same table, but COUNT must name a column of the checks, or a product with none counts 1.
